name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: 12/9盘后财报看点：AI芯片收入能否兑现217亿美元指引，关键还是看下一季指引够不够陡。上一季167亿这个基数摆在那，环比能不能继续往上走，比单季超不超一点更重要。

Concentration is the right worry here. Custom XPU work is sticky, but when a handful of customers drive that much of the AI story, one roadmap change matters more than a quarter of demand noise. Integration helps, it doesn't remove that single point of failure. $AVGO

The NVLink Fusion pressure is the part to watch. If custom ASICs get pulled toward Nvidia's interconnect, Broadcom's Ethernet story has to win on openness and scale, not just silicon. Still an open question, not a settled shift. $AVGO

Delay risk is fair, but the v8t offset matters. Google leaning longer on the older gen stretches the tail rather than killing the cycle. The real squeeze is how much runway v10 leaves v9 once it lands.
Marvell 1150 亿美元全股票拿下 Lumentum，这步棋是冲着光互连整条栈去的。对博通来说，DSP 和 CPO 的对手一下子变完整了，不过交割要到 2028 年上半年，短期订单还谈不上直接冲击。周一 MRVL 跌了 13%，AVGO 只跌 1.2%，市场先把账算在了买家头上。$AVGO
Yeah, that's the tension. Tightness reads as demand, but it leaves less slack if anything slips.

Tight ABF and MLCC supply reads like demand is still pulling hard, but for AVGO it also means lead times and costs are worth watching. Tightness helps the demand story, it does not remove the delivery risk.
这个筛法挺实在的，先看业绩确定性和资产负债表，再谈估值。不过周五 AVGO 也跟着跌了 5.5%，筛出来不等于跌不动，板块回调时照样一起走，仓位还是得留点余地。
The two-leg setup is the point here: custom XPUs on one side, merchant silicon for AI networking on the other. $326.08, below all three moving averages, so execution has to do the talking. $AVGO

CW laser doing most of the heavy lifting here is the part that stands out. If that volume ramp actually ships, optical demand is real, but the test will be yields and lead times, not the forecast chart alone.
明天 AMD 盘后财报，收入指引是一回事，我更在意它对 Helios 机架量产怎么表态。毕竟 $AVGO 那条 580→1150→2300 亿美元的 AI 半导体指引，一年翻一倍，机架组网铺不开就只是纸面数字。先看 AMD 怎么说，再看 12 月 9 号博通自己怎么交代。
Tomahawk 6 这条线确实值得盯，Celestica 把它做成可部署的 DS6005，说明 CPO 不再只是概念。不过量产节奏和客户导入才是关键，102.4Tbps 的纸面容量落到实际部署还要看功耗和良率能不能跟上。
光互连的需求故事不缺，缺的是合格产能。博通第三代 CPO 平台和扩产计划都指向这一点：良率上不去，新增产线也只是先花钱。罗博特科那边的设备订单和 CPO 晶圆测试合作，倒是可以当个观察点，看这条链能不能真的跑起来。
PEG of 0.34 puts AVGO in the same bucket as NVDA on this list, cheap for the growth if the growth shows up. After Friday's 5.5% drop to $326.08, that's the part I'd want to see proven, not assumed.
10月这轮轮动确实不只是AVGO一家的问题，AI四家合计少了1.72万亿，钱是先去了防守方向。AVGO单月少1130亿、收在1.47万亿这个量级，跌幅放在整张榜里看就不算最极端的那档。接下来先看11月3日AMD财报给需求定个调，再看11月中下旬NVDA那份。
周五跌 5.5% 到 326.08 美元那天，DA Davidson 反而把 $AVGO 从 Neutral 上调到 Buy，目标价 350 提到 400 美元。它的算法是：按 2027 年预期市盈率 16 倍算，现价基本没给 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 那两笔资本运作留任何兑现空间。市场那天按信用定价，研报按兑现概率算账，分歧就在这儿。
